# Claude Tools

<!-- generated by `Vortex.Editor --mcp-tools-md=docs/wiki/Claude-Tools.md` — do not edit by hand -->

The 64 tools the Vortex editor offers to Claude — over the MCP server (Claude Code / Claude Desktop, where they appear as `mcp__vortex__<name>`) and in the embedded Claude panel. Setup: [Claude Integration](Claude-Integration). Every call that changes the scene is **one undo step** named `Claude: …`; **read-only** tools never change anything.

## Assets

### `add_library_asset`

Copies an asset library entry (search_library id) into the open project (a model brings its textures; the default folder per type) and optionally places a model/prefab in the scene. Content the project already has is reused, not copied twice.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` **(required)** | integer | Library entry id from search_library. |
| `folder` | string | Target folder relative to the project (default: by type) |
| `place` | boolean | Place a model or prefab in the active scene. Default: `false`. |
| `position` | number[] | World position for place [x, y, z]. |

### `create_prefab`

Saves an entity (with its children) as a prefab, Assets/Prefabs/<name>.ventity; the entity becomes a linked instance. place_asset puts more instances in the scene.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` **(required)** | string | Entity id, path or name. |
| `name` | string | Prefab name (default: the entity's name) |
| `overwrite` | boolean | Replace an existing prefab of that name. Default: `false`. |

### `download_store_asset` · internet

Downloads a search_store result into the asset library (hash-checked, license recorded) and, by default, into the open project. Waits up to wait_seconds; a longer download keeps running — poll get_download_status with the job id.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `provider` **(required)** | string | Provider id, as in search_store. |
| `id` **(required)** | string | Item id from search_store. |
| `variant` | string | Variant id (e.g. 2k, 4k; default: the source's default) |
| `add_to_project` | boolean | Also copy it into the open project. Default: `true`. |
| `wait_seconds` | integer | Seconds to wait for the download. Default: `30`. |

### `get_download_status` · read-only

State of an Asset Store download (job id from download_store_asset): progress, and when done the files in the project and the license.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `job` **(required)** | integer | Job id. |
| `wait_seconds` | integer | Seconds to wait for it to finish. Default: `0`. |

### `list_assets` · read-only

Files in the project's Assets folder by kind: model, texture, material, prefab, audio, script, scene, shader, animation, vfx, ui (omit for all). Paths are what the other tools take (e.g. place_asset, set_material_properties).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string | Kind of asset. |
| `filter` | string | Only paths containing this text. |
| `folder` | string | Only below this folder, e.g. Assets/Models. |
| `limit` | integer | Maximum results. Default: `100`. |

### `place_asset`

Places a project asset in the active scene: an imported model (.glb/.gltf/.fbx/.obj …), a prefab (.ventity — a linked instance) or a primitive ("Primitive:Cube"). position is in world space (default: in front of the editor camera). One undo step.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `asset` **(required)** | string | Project path of the model / prefab, or Primitive:Cube\|Sphere\|Cylinder\|Plane\|Capsule\|Quad. |
| `position` | number[] | World position [x, y, z]. |
| `rotation` | number[] | Rotation [x, y, z] in degrees. |
| `scale` | number[] | Scale [x, y, z] (or [s]) |
| `parent` | string | Parent entity. |
| `name` | string | Name of the new entity. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what this call would create, remove, change and write — nothing is changed. Default: `false`. |

### `search_library` · read-only

Searches the user's PC-wide asset library (everything downloaded or imported in any project): name/tag text, type (model, texture, material, audio, …), tags. Returns entry ids for add_library_asset, with source and license.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | Search text. |
| `type` | string | Asset type: model, texture, material, prefab, audio, script, scene, shader, animation. |
| `tags` | string[] | All of these tags. |
| `limit` | integer | Maximum results. Default: `30`. |

### `search_store` · read-only · internet

Searches a free asset source of the Asset Store: polyhaven (CC0 models, materials, HDRIs), ambientcg (CC0 materials), kenney (CC0 packs), polypizza (low-poly models), freesound (sounds), sketchfab (models). Results carry their license — credit authors where the license asks for attribution (CC-BY). Non-commercial and no-derivatives licenses are filtered out.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `provider` **(required)** | string | polyhaven, ambientcg, kenney, polypizza, freesound or sketchfab. |
| `query` **(required)** | string | Search text. |
| `kind` | string | model, material, hdri, texture, sound, animation or pack. |
| `page` | integer | Results page (0 = first) Default: `0`. |
| `limit` | integer | Results per page. Default: `20`. |

## Audio

### `audition_clip` · read-only

Plays a sound in the editor so the user can hear it (a project path or a library entry id). One at a time; stop_audition stops it.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | Project path of the sound. |
| `library_id` | integer | Or: asset library entry id. |
| `volume` | number | Volume 0–1. Default: `0.8`. |
| `loop` | boolean | Loop until stop_audition. Default: `false`. |

### `configure_audio_source`

Sets up an entity's AudioSource (added when missing): clip (project path), volume, pitch, loop, play_on_awake, spatial (true = 3D), min_distance, max_distance, rolloff_mode, bus (Master|Music|SFX|Ambience|UI), priority, streaming, enable_occlusion, enable_hrtf … any AudioSource property. One undo step.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` **(required)** | string | Entity id, path or name. |
| `properties` **(required)** | any JSON | Properties {"clip": "Assets/Audio/hum.wav", "loop": true, "spatial": true, "max_distance": 12, "bus": "Ambience"}. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what this call would create, remove, change and write — nothing is changed. Default: `false`. |

### `generate_sound` · internet

Generates a sound effect from a text prompt with the Sound Studio and saves it to the asset library and the project (returns the path for configure_audio_source). backend: procedural (free, offline synth), elevenlabs, fal-cassette-sfx, fal-stable-audio, stability-audio-2.5, stability-audio-3 — the AI backends use the user's own API key and may cost credits. Default: the first AI backend that has a key, else procedural. Describe the sound concretely: source, material, space, length.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `prompt` **(required)** | string | What it sounds like, e.g. "heavy wooden door creaking open slowly in a stone corridor". |
| `duration` | number | Length in seconds (backend limits apply) |
| `loop` | boolean | Make it loop seamlessly (ambiences) Default: `false`. |
| `backend` | string | Backend id (see description) |
| `name` | string | Name of the asset (default: from the prompt) |
| `add_to_project` | boolean | Also copy it into the project. Default: `true`. |

### `get_mixer_state` · read-only

The audio mixer: each bus (Master, Music, SFX, Ambience, UI) with volume in dB, mute and the current level.

_No parameters._

### `search_audio` · read-only

Finds sounds by name/tag text: the project's audio files and the user's asset library (library entries can be brought in with add_library_asset). Returns duration, channels and source/license.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | Search text, e.g. footstep, door creak, ambience. |
| `limit` | integer | Maximum results per source. Default: `20`. |

### `set_bus_volume`

Sets a mixer bus volume in dB (0 = unchanged level, −6 = half, −80 = silent) and/or mute — saved in the project's mixer settings (what the game starts with). One undo step.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `bus` **(required)** | string | Master, Music, SFX, Ambience or UI. |
| `db` | number | Volume in dB (−80 … +6) |
| `mute` | boolean | Mute the bus. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what this call would create, remove, change and write — nothing is changed. Default: `false`. |

### `stop_audition` · read-only

Stops the sound audition_clip started.

_No parameters._

## Editor

### `get_editor_info` · read-only

What the Vortex editor has open: engine version, project, active scene, play state, selection, undo state. Call it first to check the connection.

_No parameters._

### `get_history` · read-only

The editor's undo history, newest first (your steps are named 'Claude: …'), and what can be redone.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | Maximum entries. Default: `20`. |

### `redo` · editor state

Redoes step(s) that were undone.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `steps` | integer | How many steps. Default: `1`. |

### `undo` · editor state

Undoes the last step(s) of the editor's undo history — each of your mutating calls is one step ('Claude: …'), but the user's own edits are on the same stack: check get_history first.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `steps` | integer | How many steps. Default: `1`. |

## Materials

### `assign_material`

Gives entities a material. For an imported model, all its submeshes get it unless submesh picks one (0-based). A store material that knows its real-world size, put on a cube/plane floor or wall, is tiled for the object's size (a copy named <material>_<W>x<H>m.vmat).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entities` **(required)** | string[] | Entities (ids, paths or names) |
| `material` **(required)** | string | Project path of the .vmat. |
| `submesh` | integer | Submesh index of an imported model (default: all) Default: `-1`. |

### `create_material`

Creates a material (.vmat) in the project — by default in Assets/Materials — with optional properties (same names as set_material_properties) and assigns it to entities if given. One undo step (Undo deletes the file).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` **(required)** | string | Material name (also the file name) |
| `properties` | any JSON | Properties, e.g. {"base_color": "#8a3b2a", "roughness": 0.8, "metallic": 0.2}. |
| `folder` | string | Folder relative to the project. Default: `"Assets/Materials"`. |
| `assign_to` | string[] | Entities to assign it to. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what this call would create, remove, change and write — nothing is changed. Default: `false`. |

### `get_material` · read-only

All settings of a material (.vmat): colors, PBR values, textures (as project paths, flagged when missing), blend mode, tiling, shader.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `material` **(required)** | string | Project path of the .vmat, e.g. Assets/Materials/Rust.vmat. |

### `list_materials` · read-only

The project's materials (.vmat): path, base color, albedo texture, and how many entities of the active scene use each.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `filter` | string | Only paths containing this text. |
| `limit` | integer | Maximum results. Default: `100`. |

### `set_material_properties`

Edits a material file — every entity that uses it changes. Properties: base_color ("#rrggbb" or [r,g,b,a]), metallic, roughness, ambient_occlusion, normal_strength, height_scale, emissive_color, emissive_strength, alpha_cutoff, blend_mode (Opaque|AlphaBlend|AlphaTest|Additive), shader_type (StandardPBR|Unlit|Subsurface), two_sided, cast_shadows, receive_shadows, uv_tiling [u,v], uv_offset [u,v], real_world_size [w,h] metres, textures as project paths (albedo_texture, normal_texture, roughness_texture, metallic_texture, ao_texture, emissive_texture, height_texture, opacity_texture; "" removes), shader_asset, footstep_sound.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `material` **(required)** | string | Project path of the .vmat. |
| `properties` **(required)** | any JSON | Properties {"name": value}. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what this call would create, remove, change and write — nothing is changed. Default: `false`. |

## Scenes

### `add_component`

Adds a component to an entity, optionally with properties, e.g. type 'Light' properties {"light_type": "Spot", "intensity": 4, "color": "#ffd8a0"}. list_component_types shows all types and properties.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` **(required)** | string | Entity id, path or name. |
| `type` **(required)** | string | Component type, e.g. Light, BoxCollider, Rigidbody, AudioSource, MeshRenderer. |
| `properties` | any JSON | Property values {"name": value}. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what this call would create, remove, change and write — nothing is changed. Default: `false`. |

### `create_entity`

Creates an entity in the active scene and returns it. kind: empty, folder, cube, sphere, capsule, cylinder, plane, quad, point_light, spot_light, directional_light, camera, audio_source, reverb_zone. Primitives are 1 m (cube 1×1×1, sphere/cylinder Ø 1 m, cylinder 1 m high, plane 1×1 m lying in XZ — scale it, e.g. [20, 1, 20]). Optional parent, local position/rotation/scale, extra components with properties: [{"type":"BoxCollider"}, {"type":"Light","properties":{"intensity":3}}]. One undo step.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string | What to create. Default: `"empty"`. |
| `name` | string | Name (default: from the kind) |
| `parent` | string | Parent entity (default: scene root) |
| `position` | number[] | Local position [x, y, z] in metres. |
| `rotation` | number[] | Local rotation [x, y, z] in degrees. |
| `scale` | number[] | Local scale [x, y, z] (or [s] for uniform) |
| `components` | any JSON | Extra components: [{"type": "…", "properties": {…}}]. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what this call would create, remove, change and write — nothing is changed. Default: `false`. |

### `delete_entities`

Deletes entities (with their children) from the scene. One undo step. dry_run lists what would be deleted.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entities` **(required)** | string[] | Entity ids, paths or names. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what would be deleted. Default: `false`. |

### `duplicate_entities`

Duplicates entities (deep copy with children, new ids) next to the originals, optionally moved by an offset. One undo step.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entities` **(required)** | string[] | Entity ids, paths or names. |
| `offset` | number[] | Move each copy by [x, y, z] metres. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what this call would create, remove, change and write — nothing is changed. Default: `false`. |

### `find_entities` · read-only

Finds entities in the active scene. All filters are optional and combine: name (case-insensitive, * wildcards, otherwise substring), tag, component type, under (an ancestor). Returns id, name, path and component types.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | Name filter: 'Lamp*', '*wall*' or a substring. |
| `tag` | string | Exact tag. |
| `component` | string | Component type the entity must have, e.g. Light, BoxCollider, AudioSource. |
| `under` | string | Only descendants of this entity. |
| `limit` | integer | Maximum results. Default: `50`. |

### `get_entity` · read-only

Everything about one entity: transform (local, plus world position under a parent), every component with its editable properties (the names set_component_properties accepts), children, prefab link.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` **(required)** | string | Entity id, path or name. |

### `get_selection` · read-only

The entities the user has selected in the editor ("this", "the selected lamp").

_No parameters._

### `list_component_types` · read-only

Component types add_component accepts, each with its settable properties and value types (enums list their values).

_No parameters._

### `list_scenes` · read-only

Lists the project's scenes: name, file, whether it is the active (edited) scene, entity count, unsaved changes.

_No parameters._

### `open_scene`

Makes a scene the active (edited) scene — by name, or by .vscene path relative to the project (loaded into the project if needed).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `scene` **(required)** | string | Scene name or project-relative .vscene path. |

### `parent_entity`

Moves an entity under a new parent. keep_world (default) keeps it where it is in the world; false keeps its local values.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` **(required)** | string | Entity to move. |
| `parent` **(required)** | string | New parent. |
| `keep_world` | boolean | Keep the world position/rotation/scale. Default: `true`. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what this call would create, remove, change and write — nothing is changed. Default: `false`. |

### `remove_component`

Removes a component from an entity (the Transform cannot be removed).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` **(required)** | string | Entity id, path or name. |
| `type` **(required)** | string | Component type. |
| `index` | integer | Which one when the entity has several of that type (0 = first) Default: `0`. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what this call would create, remove, change and write — nothing is changed. Default: `false`. |

### `save_scene`

Saves a scene to its .vscene file (default: the active scene). Tool edits live in memory until saved.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `scene` | string | Scene name (default: the active scene) |

### `scene_outline` · read-only

The active scene's hierarchy as an indented tree: 'name [id] Component, Component'. Depth- and count-limited; collapsed branches show how many entities they hide. Pass root to outline one subtree.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `max_depth` | integer | Deepest level to expand (0 = top level only) Default: `3`. |
| `max_entities` | integer | Maximum number of lines. Default: `150`. |
| `root` | string | Entity to start from (default: the whole scene) |

### `select_entities` · read-only

Selects entities in the editor (hierarchy + inspector), e.g. to show the user what you changed. Empty list clears the selection.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entities` **(required)** | string[] | Entity ids, paths or names. |

### `set_component_properties`

Sets properties of an entity's component: {"intensity": 2.5, "light_type": "Spot", "color": "#ff8800"}. Names as get_entity shows them (snake_case or PascalCase); enums take their names; vectors [x, y, z]; 'enabled' turns the component on/off. Errors list the valid names and values.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` **(required)** | string | Entity id, path or name. |
| `component` **(required)** | string | Component type, e.g. Light. |
| `properties` **(required)** | any JSON | Property values {"name": value}. |
| `index` | integer | Which component when the entity has several of that type (0 = first) Default: `0`. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what this call would create, remove, change and write — nothing is changed. Default: `false`. |

### `set_entity`

Renames an entity and/or sets its tag, active state (inactive = hidden and not simulated) and static flag.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` **(required)** | string | Entity id, path or name. |
| `name` | string | New name. |
| `tag` | string | Tag, e.g. Player, Enemy, Pickup. |
| `active` | boolean | Active in the scene. |
| `static` | boolean | Static (never moves; batched) |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what this call would create, remove, change and write — nothing is changed. Default: `false`. |

### `set_transform`

Sets an entity's position (metres), rotation (Euler degrees) and/or scale; omitted parts stay. space 'world' places it in world coordinates even under a transformed parent.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` **(required)** | string | Entity id, path or name. |
| `position` | number[] | Position [x, y, z]. |
| `rotation` | number[] | Rotation [x, y, z] in degrees. |
| `scale` | number[] | Scale [x, y, z] (or [s]) |
| `space` | string | 'local' (relative to the parent, default) or 'world'. Default: `"local"`. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what this call would create, remove, change and write — nothing is changed. Default: `false`. |

### `unparent_entity`

Moves an entity to the scene root. keep_world (default) keeps it where it is in the world.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` **(required)** | string | Entity to move. |
| `keep_world` | boolean | Keep the world position/rotation/scale. Default: `true`. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what this call would create, remove, change and write — nothing is changed. Default: `false`. |

## Scripts

### `attach_script`

Adds a script to an entity (its behaviour runs in play mode) and sets public fields of the behaviour: {"Speed": 2.5, "Target": "Door", "Offset": [0, 1, 0]} — numbers, bools, strings, enums by name, [x,y,z], arrays. One undo step.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` **(required)** | string | Entity id, path or name. |
| `script` **(required)** | string | Script name or path. |
| `fields` | any JSON | Public field values {"Field": value}. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what this call would create, remove, change and write — nothing is changed. Default: `false`. |

### `compile_scripts` · read-only

Compiles all project scripts exactly like Play does and returns the errors (and optionally warnings) with file, line and column.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `warnings` | boolean | Include warnings. Default: `false`. |

### `edit_script`

Replaces an exact piece of text in a script (it must occur exactly once unless replace_all), then compiles and returns the errors. Cheaper than write_script for small fixes. One undo step.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `script` **(required)** | string | Script name or path. |
| `old_text` **(required)** | string | Exact text to replace (include enough context to be unique) |
| `new_text` **(required)** | string | Replacement text. |
| `replace_all` | boolean | Replace every occurrence. Default: `false`. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what this call would create, remove, change and write — nothing is changed. Default: `false`. |

### `get_scripting_api` · read-only

The real Vortex scripting API (namespace Vortex), read from the engine — use it instead of guessing Unity names. Without topic: the types and a primer. With topic (e.g. VortexBehaviour, Input, Physics, Audio, Scene, Animation): its members.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `topic` | string | Type name, e.g. Input. |

### `list_scripts` · read-only

The project's scripts (Assets/Scripts) with the VortexBehaviour classes they define and how many entities of the active scene use them.

_No parameters._

### `read_script` · read-only

The source of a project script.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `script` **(required)** | string | Script name or path, e.g. Door or Assets/Scripts/Door.cs. |

### `write_script`

Creates or replaces a script in Assets/Scripts with the given C# source, then compiles the project and returns the errors (file, line, column). A behaviour derives from Vortex.VortexBehaviour (Start, Update(float dt), OnTriggerEnter … — see get_scripting_api). While the game runs, the change hot-reloads. One undo step (Undo restores the old file).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `script` **(required)** | string | Script name or path, e.g. FlickerLight or AI/Guard.cs. |
| `code` **(required)** | string | The complete C# source. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what this call would create, remove, change and write — nothing is changed. Default: `false`. |

## Viewport

### `capture_viewport` · read-only

Returns an image of the editor viewport as it is now (edit mode: the editor camera; play mode: the game). Frame the subject first with focus_camera. Use it to check your work.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `max_size` | integer | Longest side of the image in pixels (256–2048) Default: `1280`. |
| `png` | boolean | PNG instead of JPEG (exact pixels, larger) Default: `false`. |
| `focus` | string[] | Frame these entities before capturing. |
| `gizmos` | boolean | Keep the editor overlays (selection outline, move gizmo, light/camera icons) in the image. Default: `false`. |

### `engine_stats` · read-only

Renderer statistics of the last frame: FPS, draw calls, vertices, instances tested/drawn by culling, entity count.

_No parameters._

### `enter_play_mode` · editor state

Starts play mode (compiles the project scripts first). Returns the play state, script compile errors (file, line, message) and errors logged while starting. Scene changes made while playing are thrown away when play stops.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `run_seconds` | number | Seconds to let the game run before answering. Default: `1`. |

### `exit_play_mode` · editor state

Stops play mode and returns to editing (the scene is restored to its state before play).

_No parameters._

### `focus_camera` · read-only

Moves the editor camera (edit mode): frame entities (fits them in view), or look from position at look_at. Returns the camera position. Does not change the scene.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entities` | string[] | Entities to frame. |
| `position` | number[] | Camera position [x, y, z]. |
| `look_at` | number[] | Point to look at [x, y, z]. |
| `angles` | number[] | Viewing direction when framing: yaw, pitch in degrees (default: the current direction, pitch at least 15° down) |

### `get_play_state` · read-only

Whether the editor is editing, playing or paused.

_No parameters._

### `read_console` · read-only

Recent editor console lines (newest last): engine messages, warnings, errors and script Debug.Log output.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `severity` | string | 'all', 'warning' (warnings and errors) or 'error'. Default: `"all"`. |
| `limit` | integer | Maximum lines. Default: `50`. |
| `contains` | string | Only lines containing this text. |

## World

### `align_entities`

Aligns entities on one world axis: 'min' / 'center' / 'max' line up their bounds with the first entity's, 'distribute' spaces them evenly between the two outermost. One undo step.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entities` **(required)** | string[] | Entities (at least 2) |
| `axis` **(required)** | string | x, y or z. |
| `mode` | string | min, center, max or distribute. Default: `"center"`. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what this call would create, remove, change and write — nothing is changed. Default: `false`. |

### `bulk_set_properties`

Sets component properties on EVERY entity matching the filters (name with * wildcards, tag, component, under) that has that component — e.g. dim all ceiling lights: name "Lamp*", component Light, properties {"intensity": 0.6}. Reports the affected count; dry_run lists the matches. One undo step.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `component` **(required)** | string | Component type to edit, e.g. Light. |
| `properties` **(required)** | any JSON | Property values {"name": value}. |
| `name` | string | Name filter ('Lamp*', substring) |
| `tag` | string | Tag filter. |
| `under` | string | Only descendants of this entity. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report the matches. Default: `false`. |

### `get_bounds` · read-only

World-space bounding box (min, max, size, center in metres) of entities including their children — to plan where things fit.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entities` **(required)** | string[] | Entities. |

### `measure` · read-only

Distance between two entities: between their positions, and the gap between their bounding boxes (0 when they touch or overlap).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `a` **(required)** | string | First entity. |
| `b` **(required)** | string | Second entity. |

### `place_grid`

Places rows × cols copies in a grid (rows along Z, cols along X) inside a new group entity — floor tiles, wall segments, pillars, ceiling lights. source: a kind (cube, point_light, …), a project asset (model / .ventity prefab / Primitive:Cube) or an existing entity (id/path) to copy. One undo step.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `source` **(required)** | string | What to place. |
| `origin` **(required)** | number[] | World position of the first copy [x, y, z]. |
| `rows` **(required)** | integer | Rows (along +Z) |
| `cols` **(required)** | integer | Columns (along +X) |
| `spacing` **(required)** | number[] | Spacing in metres: [x, z] or one number for both. |
| `rotation` | number[] | Rotation of every copy [x, y, z] degrees. |
| `scale` | number[] | Scale of every copy [x, y, z] (or [s]) |
| `name` | string | Name of the group (and prefix of the copies) |
| `parent` | string | Parent of the group. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what would be created. Default: `false`. |

### `scatter`

Scatters count copies over an area: each lands on the highest surface below from_height (the tops of mesh bounding boxes — floors, platforms, tables) with optional random yaw and scale. Debris, rocks, crates, bottles, props. Deterministic for a given seed. source as in place_grid. One undo step.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `source` **(required)** | string | What to scatter. |
| `area_min` **(required)** | number[] | Area corner [x, z] (world) |
| `area_max` **(required)** | number[] | Opposite area corner [x, z] (world) |
| `count` **(required)** | integer | Number of copies. |
| `seed` | integer | Random seed — same seed, same layout. Default: `1`. |
| `random_yaw` | boolean | Random rotation around Y. Default: `true`. |
| `scale_range` | number[] | Random uniform scale range [min, max] (default [1, 1]) |
| `min_distance` | number | Keep at least this distance (m) between copies. Default: `0`. |
| `fallback_y` | number | Height to use where nothing is below (default: skip that spot) |
| `from_height` | number | World height the downward rays start at (default: above everything). Indoors, use a height below the ceiling. |
| `name` | string | Name of the group. |
| `parent` | string | Parent of the group. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what would be created. Default: `false`. |

### `snap_to_grid`

Rounds entities' world positions to a grid (cell size in metres) on the given axes. One undo step.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entities` **(required)** | string[] | Entities. |
| `cell` | number | Cell size in metres. Default: `1`. |
| `axes` | string | Axes to snap, e.g. "xz" or "xyz". Default: `"xyz"`. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | Only report what this call would create, remove, change and write — nothing is changed. Default: `false`. |
